purpose: Target capability profile for keeping the screen expression layer WBA55-safe while allowing explicit WBA65 expansion.

WB55_DEVBOARD.platform_scope: WB55 owns CPU2/FUS/IPCC/HSEM/STM32_WPAN glue, UTIL_SEQ/HW_TS scheduling, and the current dry-run panel target adapter.

WBA55.expansion_policy: No common screen protocol, queue, or payload expansion without preserving this WBA55-safe profile.
WBA55.platform_scope: First WBA port must use a separate CubeWBA project, WBA build wrapper, WBA BLE/GATT adapter, WBA scheduler/timer hook, and *_stm32wba.* panel adapter.

WBA65.expansion_policy: Expanded resources must not change shared ExpressionV1 IDs, CardStatusV1 meanings, display queue bounds, or real BLE evidence shape.
WBA65.platform_scope: May use additional WBA65 resources only behind target capability flags and only after the WBA55-safe contract still passes.

wba_expansion_rules: WBA55 is the safe baseline for shared screen protocol, queue, payload, and diagnostic contracts.
WBA65 may add target-specific resources only behind explicit capability flags.
Any larger WBA65-only payload, queue, panel feature, or low-power path must keep a WBA55-safe fallback and new validation evidence.
Do not retarget the WB55 Cube project in place; create a separate CubeWBA project and build wrapper.
Do not move BLE stack, scheduler, SPI/GPIO/BUSY, reset timing, pins, or board power policy into portable screen files.
